query:
DELETE FROM inbound_source_checkpoints
             WHERE rowid IN (
                 SELECT rowid FROM inbound_source_checkpoints
                 WHERE active = 0 AND updated_at < ?1
                 UNION
                 SELECT rowid FROM (
                     SELECT rowid FROM inbound_source_checkpoints
                     WHERE active = 0
                     ORDER BY updated_at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?2
                 )
             )
